title: Very Pleased
text:
The Vinyl-Of-The-Month Club (which should be called a RECORD-of-the-month, but I'm old so what do I know) has been working out very well so far.
I am an older guy with a largish record collection that enjoys filling holes in my collection. I have a steady lady who has been building her own collection from scratch for the past few years. Between us, there has not been a single mailing from the Club that we did not appreciate.
We joined last summer. Our first record was Pink Floyd's DSOTM (the stellar 2016 remaster). Since then we have received records by The Clash, The Who, The Supremes and others. Most of them have been double albums. All of them have been extremely good pressings. Many of them have been cheaper at the club price than if I had simply ordered them from Amazon individually. Every one has been an essential album for a well-rounded collection.
So far, the only hiccup has been that we never saw the January 2022 album. For us, that would have been Let It Be by The Beatles. On one hand, I understand why it probably isn't available - The Beatles are currently thin in North America due to recent manufacturing changes. On the other hand, I don't know why they wouldn't have skipped along to the next record or substituted something else. It hasn't been devastating; Amazon doesn't charge for them until they ship so we aren't out any money. But we have already gotten to looking forward to the monthly record.
In any case, barring that anomaly, this club has been a great experience so far. Anyone who has been collecting rock albums for a long time may already have most of what is on offer here. But if you are building, or rebuilding, a collection then this is a very good way to put together many of the essentials.
Update : Shortly after posting this review, that Beatles/Let It Be record held over from January showed up. It was properly packaged for shipping and on great shape. I have reviewed Let It Be on that product page. Still very happy with the service.
label: positive
